# Korium Komblete built-in theme

Graphics by **Berion**, original theme script by **KrahJohlito and Ripto**.
The former built-in port came from NathanNeurotic/Open-PS2-Loader at the
revision recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`. The original configuration, asset
archive, and stand-in badges are available in repository history. The
repository's AFL-3.0 license applied to the downstream port.
